'''2020 TMW Round of 16 Steve Baroni DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Round of 16).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open AOBS Baroni DS 2020 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Round of 16
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
